objective: Preserve convexity in already-qualified Pump/Pons winners by replacing Pump Current's fixed return-point trail, carrying proven Current runners across the pre-Survivor time gap on the same lifecycle, and freezing one bounded add-to-winner stage from external market evidence.

common_tail_mode.reference_basis: original entry reference price / original lifecycle high-water; scale-in basis must not reset or dilute tail high-water
common_tail_mode.trigger_formula: once high_water_return_bps >= 10000, full price-trail exit when current_return_bps <= floor(high_water_return_bps * 6000 / 10000)
unchanged_precedence: invalid or missing executable exit liquidity
common_tail_mode.note: The 40% accrued-gain giveback is a bounded tail compromise. It is not intended to survive every extreme retracement; later independent Survivor/reset-recovery re-entry remains available.

pump_survivor.before_tail_arm: retain existing 20% trail, tightening to 15% at +60%

pons_survivor.before_tail_arm: retain existing 12% trail, tightening to 10% at +40%

current_tail_bridge.strategy_identity: same Current lifecycle; lifecycle state only, not a new lane or independent entry strategy
current_tail_bridge.transition_point: normal Current thesis/max-hold timeout, only if every bridge gate passes; otherwise existing timeout exit remains
current_tail_bridge.trail_management: use regime pre-arm trail until +100% high-water, then common_tail_mode

add_size.formula: min(2.5% of reconciled realized sleeve equity, 50% of original committed basis, currently available sleeve capital, turnover/depth/stress/breadth caps)

risk_semantics.deterministic_lot_rule: first realization must already be committed before scaling; any future post-add partial extension must reduce lots pro-rata by quantity

calibration_sanity_checks.assumptions: Full 5% sleeve initial fill, sleeve is 25% of portfolio, 25% first realization at Pump Current +15%, no costs/slippage beyond strategy return representation, scale fills at 2x, terminal tail exit follows the 40% accrued-gain giveback. These are deterministic structural checks, not forecasts.

required_proofs_before_promotion: Pump Current no longer contains a fixed return-point runner trail; below +100% it uses proportional high-water price drawdown and above +100% common tail mode.
Exact boundary tests at 2x, 5x, 10x, 25x and 50x reproduce the frozen tail thresholds.
Current timeout enters tail_bridge only when every bridge gate passes; an ordinary/non-tail Current position still exits on its original timeout.
Bridge uses the same native lifecycle and sleeve reservation with no sell/rebuy, no new capital and no reset of high-water/risk state.
Restart/replay reconstructs bridge state, original high-water, first-realization state, deterioration state and bridge deadline identically.
Survivor observation can proceed while bridge exposure is open but same-asset Survivor allocation is rejected by the shared-sleeve conflict fence.
One scale event can occur only after +100% high-water, first realization, 15-minute persistence and fresh full safety/execution requalification.
Scale amount is downsize-only and never exceeds 250 bps of realized sleeve equity, 50% of original committed basis, available capital or existing execution-capacity limits.
Scale cannot reset original-entry high-water, stop state, bridge age or exit intent.
Exact-SHA deterministic and non-market certification passes after composition.
Affected Pump/Pons profitability cohorts restart because exit duration and economic exposure change.
composition_order: reset-recovery remains separate research unless independently promoted
